name: Museo del Prado
desc: Velázquez, Goya and Bosch's nightmares under one roof. Free entry the last two hours daily — the broke traveler cheat code.

name: El Retiro Park
desc: Madrid's backyard: row a boat past a glass palace, dodge rollerbladers, nap like royalty under very old trees.

name: Royal Palace
desc: Europe's biggest royal pad by floor space — thousands of chandelier-heavy rooms. The kings moved out; the swagger stayed.

name: Plaza Mayor
desc: A 400-year-old square that's hosted markets, fiestas and worse. Coffee costs triple here; standing costs nothing.

name: Puerta del Sol
desc: Kilometre Zero of all Spain. Touch the plaque, find the bear statue, feel briefly like the center of everything.

name: Reina Sofía Museum
desc: Home of Picasso's Guernica — a wall-sized gut punch. Free evening slots exist for dreamers on a budget.

name: Mercado de San Miguel
desc: A glass jewel box of tapas counters. Walk in free, inhale the jamón air, budget for one perfect bite.

name: Templo de Debod
desc: An actual Egyptian temple, gifted to Madrid, glowing at dusk. The most exotic free sunset in the city.

name: Gran Vía
desc: Madrid's Broadway — rooftop bars, giant billboards, buildings that dress up at night. Neck cranes are free.

name: El Rastro Flea Market
desc: Sunday flea-market chaos tumbling downhill — vinyl, antiques, treasure, junk. The haggling counts as cardio.
